items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a call from Justin DiCioccio at Manhattan.

ctx.x: I thought you had retired from Rutgers.
Yeah. I thought so too. But as soon as I made the decision to retire, I got a call from Justin DiCioccio at Manhattan. I said, “I’m not going to any meetings.”
“Not serving on any panels. I’m not going to any meetings.” Yeah, I got it.
